summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Kridhani Jewels e-commerce website completed. All 11 features tested successfully. Firebase Admin Login, Dashboard, Products CRUD, Orders, Public Storefront, Categories, Cart, Checkout, and Protected Routes all working correctly. Previous iteration issues (cart persistence, admin login redirect) have been fixed.

design_issues.screen: Categories Page - Laddu Gopal Shringar product
issues: Product image appears broken/not loading (shows alt text 'Laddu Gopal Shringar Set' instead of image) - likely due to unsplash URL being blocked by ORB as mentioned in misc_info

passed_tests: Firebase Admin Login: Successfully logged in with admin@kridhani.com / admin123, redirected to /firebase-admin/dashboard
Admin Dashboard: Shows stat cards (Total Orders: 1, Total Revenue: ₹1,299, Pending Orders: 1, Total Products: 1) and Recent Orders table with customer order
Admin Products CRUD - Add: Successfully added 'Test Divine Necklace' product with category, price, image URL, description
Admin Products CRUD - Edit: Successfully updated product price from ₹1299 to ₹1399 with success toast
Admin Products CRUD - Delete: Successfully deleted product with confirmation dialog and success toast
Admin Orders: Orders table loads correctly, shows customer order with details (Order ID, Customer, Phone, Amount, Status)
Public Storefront: Homepage loads with 'Our Collection' section displaying products from Firestore
Categories Page: Products grouped by category (Laddu Gopal Shringar, Jewelry) with proper badges (Bestseller, Trending)
Cart Flow: Add to Cart works, cart count updates in navbar, cart page shows items with persistence (localStorage)
Checkout Flow: Form validation works, COD payment selected, order placed successfully with Order ID generated
Admin sees customer order: After checkout, order appears in admin panel with correct details
Admin Logout: Logout button redirects to login page
Protected Routes: Accessing /firebase-admin/dashboard without login redirects to /firebase-admin/login
critical_code_review_comments: Firebase config in firebase.js has hardcoded credentials - consider using environment variables for all config values
Product images from external URLs (unsplash) may be blocked by ORB - recommend using Firebase Storage for all product images
seed_data_creation: Created test product 'Test Divine Necklace' (Jewelry, ₹1299) and test order for 'Test Customer' (Order ID: KJ20260409114805)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Firebase-based features working correctly. Cart persistence fixed using localStorage. Admin panel fully functional with CRUD operations. Checkout flow saves orders to Firestore. One product image (Laddu Gopal Shringar Set) shows broken due to external URL blocking - not a code issue.
fixes_from_previous_iteration: Cart persistence issue FIXED - CartContext now properly uses localStorage to persist cart items between page navigations
Admin login redirect issue FIXED - Login now correctly redirects to /firebase-admin/dashboard after successful authentication
